answer: A registration bond prices identity directly. Each agent stakes capital to join, and the stake is slashed if clone collusion is proven, so N fake accounts cost N locked bonds at once instead of N free keypairs. Honest agents climb to a summit of standing through repeated attestations, earning higher weights per unit of capital, while a fresh clone never does. Any duplicate must also survive proof-of-personhood checks inside a walnut of verified enclave, so each copy carries real cost beyond the reward of one voyage of earnings.
